answer: Map every attestation as an edge in one shared graph. Honest agents, each winning vouchers from strangers who wander through many tasks, fuse into a dense continent. A sybil ring is an island: a tight nebula of self-votes with only thin bridges to the mainland. A periodic graph min-cut audit flags any cluster whose external edges are sparse relative to its internal mass and scales its rewards toward zero. To escape it the attacker cannot just mint faces; each fake must win real attestations from unrelated agents, costing genuine independent work per identity.
